description.en: Jointed conifer shoots carry strongly reduced leaves forming sheathing bases.
description.zh: 分节针叶树枝具极度缩小叶及鞘状叶基。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Pseudofrenelopsis parceramosa, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Pseudofrenelopsis parceramosa 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Nearly leafless succulent-looking branches differ from both leafy conifer sprays and whorled horsetail branchlets.
distinctness.zh: 近无叶肉质感枝条区别于有叶针叶枝及木贼轮生小枝。

modeling_brief.en: Build smooth tapering internodes with visible sheath rims and tiny leaf tips; no assumed tree crown.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作光滑渐细节间、可见鞘缘及微小叶尖，不假设整树冠。

uncertainty: Morphospecies boundaries and complete habit remain uncertain; this is a shoot specimen.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Vegetative structure of a Lower Cretaceous conifer from Arkansas
sources.supports: Pseudofrenelopsis parceramosa jointed shoots and reduced helical leaves.
